LongKV: Hierarchical KV Cache Compression for Million-Token Inference

Alice Zhang, Bob Li
Abstract

We propose a hierarchical KV cache compression scheme that keeps perplexity nearly unchanged. Code is available at https://github.com/example/longkv.
